text: Episode thirteen. The questionnaire gate. A rope workshop that asks a few questions before it says yes. First as the applicant, then as the organizer.
Some events shouldn't be first come, first served. This workshop has one free tier, and a gate in front of it: a short application, read by a person.

Two sections, five questions. Multiple choice for the quick ones: how much rope experience, and whether you're coming with a partner. Free text where it matters: what you hope to learn, and anything the instructors should know about your body. A consent line at the end. The organizer wrote all of this. Revel just asks it. Submit, and it goes to a person.
Nothing to buy yet. The page says the application is being reviewed, and that's honest.
On the other side, the answers arrive exactly as they were written. Ren reads them, leaves a short note, and approves. Or doesn't. Either way, Noa hears back automatically.
Approved. The tier unlocks, and the spot is hers. One free ticket, with her name on it, sitting in her account, ready for the door on the night.
Screening that feels like care, not a bouncer. Revel is free and open source. Find it at lets revel dot io.
